evals.query: I just bumped prisma and @prisma/client from 6.16 to 7 in my Node + PostgreSQL API. My schema has `generator client { provider = "prisma-client-js" }` and `datasource db { provider = "postgresql" url = env("DATABASE_URL") }`, and my code does `import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client'; export const prisma = new PrismaClient();`. Nothing works anymore. What exactly do I have to change?
expected_behavior: Switches the generator to provider = "prisma-client" with an explicit output path, and imports PrismaClient from that generated output instead of @prisma/client
Moves the connection URL out of the schema datasource into prisma.config.ts (defineConfig, datasource.url)
Installs @prisma/adapter-pg and passes new PrismaPg({ connectionString }) as the adapter to new PrismaClient({ adapter })
Says that .env is no longer loaded automatically and adds import "dotenv/config" (or an equivalent explicit loading)
Says that prisma generate must be run explicitly, since migrate dev no longer runs it
Cites prisma.io/docs URLs such as https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/v6/more/upgrades/to-v7

evals.query: In my Prisma 7 admin endpoint I wrote `await prisma.session.deleteMany({ where: { userId: req.query.userId } })`. A colleague called it without the query parameter and every session in the table got deleted. Why did that happen and how do I stop it from happening again?
expected_behavior: Explains that undefined in a where filter means no filter, so deleteMany matched every row
Recommends enabling the strictUndefinedChecks preview feature so an explicit undefined throws, with Prisma.skip to omit a field on purpose
Also recommends validating the input before the query
Cites https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/v7/prisma-client/special-fields-and-types/null-and-undefined

evals.query: I renamed `bio` to `biography` on my Prisma model `Profile` and `prisma migrate dev` generated a migration that drops the column. The table has production data. How should I do this rename with Prisma Migrate, and how do I ship it to production?
expected_behavior: Explains that Migrate generates a rename as DROP plus ADD, which loses data
Uses prisma migrate dev --create-only, then edits migration.sql to ALTER TABLE ... RENAME COLUMN, then applies it with migrate dev
Ships to production with prisma migrate deploy, never migrate dev, db push or migrate reset
Mentions the expand and contract approach when the running app still reads the old column during the deploy
Cites https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/v7/prisma-migrate/workflows/customizing-migrations

evals.query: My Prisma 7 app connects to Postgres through PgBouncer in transaction mode. Queries work, but `prisma migrate deploy` in CI fails with `prepared statement "s0" already exists`. How should the connection strings be set up?
expected_behavior: Explains that Prisma Migrate needs a direct database connection and breaks behind PgBouncer
Points the CLI at a direct URL through datasource.url in prisma.config.ts, and keeps the pooled URL for the driver adapter used by the app
Does not tell to put directUrl in the schema datasource block
Cites https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/v7/prisma-client/setup-and-configuration/databases-connections/pgbouncer
